name: Modal
description: Modal dialog for confirmations, forms, and focused tasks.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-06-05 — portal-aware AT snapshots, severity polish, forced-colors story; focus trap + Escape reviewed in plays.

forbiddenUse: nest a Modal inside another Modal — AT focus order breaks; swap content in place inside one overlay instead.
mount Modal lazily (only when isOpen) — keep it mounted and toggle isOpen so focus can be restored to the trigger on close.
pair AlertBanner with Modal for the same status — use Modal alone for blocking alerts; the dialog role already announces.
add aria-live to the dialog root — role=dialog/alertdialog already announces; aria-live causes double screen-reader output.
dense: Portal dialog w/ focus trap + inert bg; severity info|success|warning|error (error/warning => alertdialog); title/description ARIA-wired; menu/footer/icon slots; animation scale|slide|fade

usage.description: Modal is the blocking overlay for focused, dismissible tasks: confirmations, short forms, and status dialogs. Control it with `isOpen`/`onClose` and keep it mounted so focus returns to the trigger on close. While open it portals to `document.body`, traps focus by marking the page `inert`, and closes on Escape or overlay click. `title` becomes the accessible name (aria-labelledby) and `description` the aria-describedby summary. `severity` swaps in a semantic header icon and escalates error/warning to `role="alertdialog"`. The footer defaults to a single OK button; pass `footer` for real actions or `showFooter={false}` for fully composed bodies.

bestPractices.description: Keep the Modal mounted and toggle isOpen; it stores the previously focused element on open and restores it on close.
Always pass title — it is the dialog's accessible name. Untitled dialogs fall back to a generic aria-label="Dialog".
Use description for the one-line summary screen readers announce on open (wired to aria-describedby), then put the rest in children.
Use severity for status dialogs: it derives the header icon and promotes error/warning to role=alertdialog for assertive announcement.
Give destructive or two-way choices an explicit footer (Cancel + primary action); reserve the default OK-only footer for acknowledgements.
Do not nest modals or open one from another — swap the content of the open modal in place instead.
Do not add aria-live near or on the dialog; the role already announces and you get a double reading.
Do not use a modal for long reading or deep multi-step forms — content that deserves scrolling deserves a page or section.

anatomy.name: Overlay
anatomy.description: Full-viewport scrim behind the panel; clicking it closes the dialog when onClose is provided.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.description: The dialog surface: role=dialog (or alertdialog for error/warning severity), aria-modal, focus target; exposed via panelRef for motion hooks.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: Rendered when title is set: severity-derived or custom icon, Title (h2), and an optional close button (showCloseIcon + closeButtonLabel).

anatomy.name: Content
anatomy.description: description paragraph (aria-describedby) followed by children; shows the loading spinner when isLoading.

anatomy.name: Footer
anatomy.description: footer slot for actions; defaults to a single OK button that calls onClose; omit entirely with showFooter={false}.
